doc: Drift glitch (static version of an animated glitch): the document is cut into bands of blockSize px (axis h: horizontal strips shifted along x; v: vertical strips shifted along y; band index = floor(doc coordinate / blockSize)). Over `iterations` steps every band's offset random-walks: at step i, with probability density % (hash of seed, band, i) the band moves by (u - 0.5) * 2 * amount px, u in [0,1) another hash. Total offset o (px, |o| <= iterations * amount). Green is read at round(o), red at round(o + k), blue at round(o - k), k = o * rgbShift / amount (so the colour split grows with the drift, |k| <= iterations * rgbShift); out(x) = in(x - shift). Transparent outside the layer (no wrap); alpha = max of the three channel alphas. Deterministic: pure function of input + parameters.

amount.doc: maximum offset change of a band per step

density.doc: probability that a band moves in a step

rgbShift.doc: red/blue split per amount of drift: k = o * rgbShift / amount

axis.doc: h: horizontal bands shifted along x; v: vertical bands shifted along y
